page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Page number 212 at top left, running head "DIALECTICAE" at top centre. Catchword "ante" at bottom right. Narrow dark strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nia,pacta,conuenta,queftiones,leges, senatusconsulta. Sed hæc nihil ad Dialecticam.Sensi-bus enim iudicantur, qui rationis sunt exper-tes.Itaque diuisionem hanc nusquam in logi-cis libris tradidit Aristoteles, sed in Rhetori-cis dūtaxat: vnde,si vsus venerit,depromētur.

Quot in partes tota hæc de Argumenta-tione doctrina distribuitur? Duas:in artem inueniendi & concludendi:quarum illā Græ-ci Συνθετικῶ[?], vel ὑπερτικῶ[?] : hāc κεςτικῶ[?], vel ἀναλυ-τικῶ appellant.Earum autē qui auctores fue-rint,Cicero in Topicis,sed præcipuè in lib.de Finib.4 .demonstrat : Cūmque duæ sint artes (inquit)quibus perfectè ratio & oratio com-pleatur,vna inueniendi,altera differēdi : hanc posteriorem & Stoici & Peripatetici:priorem autem illi egregiè tradiderunt: hi omnino ne attigerunt quidem.Nam è quibus locis quasi thesauris argumēta depromerentur, veftri ne fufpicati quidem sunt:superiores autem arti-ficio & via tradiderunt. Sic Antonius lib.de Orat.I I.In hac(inquit) Stoici Diogenis arte Dialectica nullum est præceptum , quomodo verum inueniatur , sed tantùm est quomodo iudicetur.Hic nos igitur Stoicus ifte nihil ad-iuuat : quoniam quemadmodum inueniam quid dicam, non docet.Quare iftam artem to tam dimittamus, quæ in excogitandis argu-mentis muta nimium est:in iudicandis, ni-mium loquax. Critolaum puto plus huic stu-dio prodesse.Erat enim ab Aristotele.ac paulò ante

page.notes: Greek words in the first and second paragraphs are doubtful: the scan is faint and the accents and some letters could not be read with certainty, so they are marked [?]. The word "fenatuf" is read as senatusconsulta, which the line break and the sense support. Some letters in "Ciceronis" and "Stoici" are not fully legible on the scan. The running head is taken as printed in spaced capitals.
